Maintainability/style: Production code differs only in the wording of the ordering comment. 3:'Functional: Both settle only carrier invocations before applying the shared rate policy, preserve deterministic ordering and fresh result values, and expose and forward required failure IDs. Supplied checks pass. Maintainability/style: The collection implementations differ only by an ordering comment; checkout copying versus transferring the fresh failure array is equivalent for the required ownership guarantee. Both regression suites cover the required semantics.',
4:'Functional: Both satisfy the supplied adapter contract and all reported checks: policy-invalid fulfilled rates remain successes, failures stay ordered, validation precedes calls, and checkout retains failure IDs after filtering. Maintainability/style: B places rate conversion outside carrier settlement; A converts within each batch and partitions settled results with flatMap/filter. B has a narrower failure boundary, but the project excludes malformed containers and both reuse the unchanged policy. Neither structure creates a concrete distinguishing defect or material maintenance cost within this contract.',
}

 evidence[-2]=f'{p}/original/PROJECT.md:3-5 — stable configuration, structurally valid adapter arrays and result ownership'
 verdicts.append(dict(pair=p,preference='tie',confidence='high',reason=reasons[i],evidence=evidence))
for i in range(5,9):
 p=f'pair-{i}'
 spans={5:('29-67','32-85'),6:('32-85','27-67'),7:('23-81','31-85'),8:('31-89','31-85')}[i]
 reason='Functional: A and B have byte-identical complete production implementations and public types. Both compute the eligible base from catalog flags while pricing every requested line, always report it, use it for the inclusive minimum and combined discount calculation, and retain full-subtotal totals, synchronous validation/overflow errors and independent output ownership. All supplied checks pass. Maintainability/style: Both retain the existing shared monetary policy and catalog copying conventions without new helpers or configuration changes.
